question:
India played in the finals of the 2023 World Test Championship against Australia.

Where was this match conducted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**London**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2023 World Test Championship** final was held in **London**.
 
• The match took place at the **Kennington Oval**, a historic cricket ground known for hosting major cricket events.
 
• I**ndia and Australia** competed in this prestigious event, marking a significant moment in international cricket.
 
• The choice of venue reflects London's status as a central hub for cricket, providing facilities and an atmosphere suitable for such a high-profile match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The World Test Championship** is an international cricket competition run by the **International Cricket Council** (ICC), aiming to bring context and significance to Test cricket.
 
• The championship was introduced to ensure that Test cricket remains the pinnacle of the sport by providing a competitive league format.
 
• The final of the championship is the culmination of a **two-year cycle** where the top two teams in the points table compete for the title.
 
• London's Kennington Oval has a rich history, having hosted numerous important cricket matches, including Test matches, One Day Internationals, and T20 Internationals.
 
• The venue is known for its excellent pitch conditions, large seating capacity, and vibrant atmosphere, making it an ideal location for the World Test Championship final.
